newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada board sets hearing for Novagas.
newsitem.headline: Canada board sets hearing for Novagas.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said on Tuesday it would hold a public hearing on an application by Novagas Clearinghouse Pipelines Ltd, a unit of NOVA Corp, to build a natural gas liquids pipeline to Alberta from northeast British Columbia.

Novagas seeks to construct about 58 km of eight-inch gas liquids pipeline to a Novagas Clearinghouse Ltd metering facility in Alberta from the Solex Developments Co Inc straddle plant at Taylor, British Columbia.

The proposed C$8 million facilities, known as the Taylor-Boundary Lake Liquids Pipeline Project, would enable gas liquids including ethane, butane and condensate, to be delivered to storage and fractionation facilities near Redwater, Alberta starting in April 1998.
The NEB said the hearing would start February 10 in Calgary and parties wishing to intervene could notify the board by December 19.
